hero.subtitle: A psychiatry-led programme for burnout, Long COVID, and midlife reinvention. We reset the biology first — because everything else depends on it.

gap.label: The gap
gap.title: Why most recovery never completes
gap.body: A dysregulated nervous system cannot be coached or willed back to health. Standard approaches fail because they skip the biology — or never address the gap between clinical discharge and functional life.

cards.title: Coaching before the body is ready
cards.body: Talk therapy and mindset work have no traction when the nervous system is still in threat response. The biology has to come first.

cards.title: The discharge gap is unmanaged
cards.body: Most clinics discharge without a structured bridge back to function. The space between treatment and life is where recovery breaks down.

cards.title: No medical anchor
cards.body: Wellness programmes lack the clinical depth to distinguish burnout from depression, or Long COVID from chronic stress. Precision matters.

method.label: The method
method.title: Hardware before software
method.subtitle: Every programme starts with your body — sleep, nervous system, and physical resilience. Only once that foundation is stable does the psychological work begin.

pillars.title: Biological reset
pillars.body: Sleep architecture, nervous system regulation, and physical recovery — sequenced and monitored. No psychological programme lands without this foundation.

pillars.title: Psychiatric guidance
pillars.body: Medically anchored from day one. Our psychiatrist establishes a clear clinical picture and keeps your programme evidence-based throughout.

pillars.title: Reintegration
pillars.body: Returning to work, reinventing what's next, or simply reclaiming your capacity — we map the gap and navigate it with you, step by step.

quote.text: The gap between clinic discharge and returning to work is where most people fall through. We exist specifically to bridge that gap — with medicine, structure, and accountability.
quote.author: Dr. Manu

who.label: For whom
who.title: High-functioning people who hit a wall
who.body: Executives, doctors, founders, creatives. People who did everything right and still burned out — or who never fully recovered from Long COVID, a health crisis, or a major life transition.

testimonials.text: I didn't realise how burned out I was until I started tracking properly. The structure gave me something to hold onto.
testimonials.author: Executive, Zürich

testimonials.text: After 18 months of Long COVID, this was the first programme that actually started with how I felt physically.
testimonials.author: Physician, Basel

process.label: The process
process.title: Simple. Structured. Clear.
process.subtitle: No guesswork. Every step is defined before you start.

steps.title: Deep assessment
steps.body: A thorough intake covering your medical history, current state, work context, and goals — so we understand the full picture before anything begins.

steps.title: Your programme
steps.body: A structured plan combining body-first protocols, regular psychiatric check-ins, and reintegration milestones. Personalised, not generic.

steps.title: Track & evolve
steps.body: Daily check-ins in the portal. We see the data. Your programme adapts as you recover — no waiting for the next appointment.

cta.body: Create your account, complete the intake, and we'll be in touch within 24 hours to schedule your initial assessment.
